# SAMA

> SAMA (سماء) is a web design and development studio in Beirut, Lebanon. It builds websites, online stores, mobile apps and interfaces, and edits video, for clients in Lebanon and worldwide.

Contact: hello@samatechlb.com

## Services
- [Web design](https://samatechlb.com/web-design-lebanon/): Fast, responsive websites and landing pages that turn visitors into customers.
- [E-commerce websites](https://samatechlb.com/ecommerce-website-lebanon/): Online stores with filters, product pages, cart and checkout that work on any phone.
- [Mobile app development](https://samatechlb.com/mobile-app-development-lebanon/): iOS and Android apps, web apps and dashboards built to grow with your business.
- [UI/UX design](https://samatechlb.com/ui-ux-design-lebanon/): User flows, wireframes and interfaces that are easy and enjoyable to use.
- [Video editing](https://samatechlb.com/video-editing-lebanon/): Reels, ads and brand films with colour grading, motion graphics and captions.
